messages:
maria_support: Escalation from Acme (via support ticket). After today's canary->prod rollout (release r-2026-03-17-09) their app reports that plugin calls to payment_gateway are being omitted when using streaming responses. Customer gave a failing request_id: req_01HXY9Z7A. They say non-streaming works.

deploy-bot: deploy r-2026-03-17-09 promoted to prod from canary (commit 3a7f9e). Canary window closed at 08:58 UTC.

dan_runtime: thanks, maria. any sample payloads or response chunks from the customer? streaming vs non-streaming sample would help.

maria_support: pasted what Acme sent: (they redacted PII)

```json
POST /v1/chat/stream
{
  "model": "redwood-2-large",
  "stream": true,
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Charge card 4111 for $19.99"}],
  "tools": ["payment_gateway"]
}
```

And their observed stream (last chunk) where the assistant emits a function call object in the token stream, but server logs show no tool.invoke event for that request_id. Customer excerpt: "...\n{\"name\":\"payment_gateway.charge\", \"args\": {\"amount\":19.99, \"card\":\"[REDACTED]\"}}\n..."

anya_sre: hmm. do we have runtime traces for req_01HXY9Z7A? grep for "tool.invoke" and "function_call_emitted" around that id. also check whether the KV cache / prefix caching caused chunk boundary issues.

maria_support: attached server snippet (redacted):

```text
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] req=req_01HXY9Z7A model=redwood-2-large stream=true route=chat/stream handler=stream-aggregator info="received assistant token chunk" chunk_idx=14
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] req=req_01HXY9Z7A handler=stream-aggregator info="assistant chunk contains potential function_call start"
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] req=req_01HXY9Z7A handler=stream-aggregator warn="function_call not emitted: chunk boundary incomplete"
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] req=req_01HXY9Z7A handler=tool-router info="no matching tool invocation enqueued"
```

maria_support: Customer also ran non-streaming: same prompt with stream=false -> we see tool.invoke event and call succeeds. So regression tied to streaming path post-rollout.

dan_runtime: that log line "function_call not emitted: chunk boundary incomplete" looks new. I think the aggregator change in the recent patch (attempt to emit earlier to reduce tail latency) added a heuristic that can drop emissions when the function_call JSON is split across chunks. Might be a race where we check for a closing brace on the chunk but the rest arrives next.

kyle_product: can we reproduce locally? maria, can you paste exact curl we can run to hit canary or a repro harness? If customer reproduced in prod, let's try a controlled run against canary.

maria_support: sure — Acme ran this curl against prod; here's a minimal repro (redacted):

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Charge card 4111 for $19.99"}],"tools":["payment_gateway"]}'
```

When streaming, the assistant emits the function_call JSON across two separate SSE chunks; aggregator logs then show the warn above and never emit tool.invoke.

anya_sre: next steps: dan, can you enable trace logging for stream-aggregator on canary and run the curl a few times (also try varying chunk sizes via the test harness so we can simulate split boundaries)? Add header X-Debug-Trace: true and paste new req ids. I'll watch SRE metrics for tool-invoke counts decreasing.

dan_runtime: on it. my hypothesis: the new early-emit heuristic returns if it doesn't see a complete json object in the chunk; it should instead buffer and retry when next chunk arrives. quick mitigation: revert that heuristic or add a fallback that schedules a short re-eval on next chunk. I'll open a hotfix branch.

maria_support: passing this back to Acme: asking for one more prod req id while we run canary tests. Customer provided an additional id: req_01HXYB2K9.

dan_runtime: thanks. I'll triage against both ids. tagging @anya_sre to correlate logs. I'll create a PR with the revert and a unit test that simulates split JSON across chunks.

kyle_product: flagging as P1 customer-impacting regression. Keep me posted. :exclamation:

maria_support: noted, I'll tell Acme we have a suspected regression from today's rollout and we're actively testing a fix. :thumbsup:
